summary_en: DM Solutions introduced progressive dividend policy whereby annual per-share dividend will not decline year-over-year and will maintain or increase from prior levels. Interim dividend for fiscal year ending March 2027 set at ¥10.50 per share, up from ¥7.50 in the prior interim period.
title_en: Notice Regarding Change in Dividend Policy (Introduction of Progressive Dividend) and Dividend from Retained Earnings (Interim Dividend)
translation_en_brief:
DM Solutions' Board of Directors approved on November 12, 2026, a fundamental change to its dividend policy by introducing a progressive dividend framework. Under this new policy, the company commits that the annual per-share dividend will not decline from the prior year and will maintain or increase as a basic principle, conditional on favorable business outlook and sustainable capital investment capacity.

The interim dividend for the six months ended September 30, 2026, was set at ¥10.50 per share with a total distribution of ¥60.7 million, representing an increase from ¥7.50 per share in the prior interim period (September 30, 2025). The company noted that this interim dividend aligns with the dividend forecast announced on June 9, 2026. Full-year dividend for fiscal 2027 is projected at ¥21.00 per share, compared to ¥18.00 per share in the prior fiscal year.

The company stated that business visibility has improved sufficiently to support this commitment. The new progressive dividend approach reflects management's judgment that capital investments for medium to long-term business expansion are proceeding as planned, while maintaining shareholder returns as a key management priority alongside enterprise value enhancement.
